nodes.note: Versioning base name. No versioning behavior implemented here.
Project lifecycle phase. Never the simulator physics phase.
Employee resource. Distinct from Contributor, not a subtype of it; permissions unresolved.
Third-party labor resource. Shared resource base and permissions unresolved.
Client party; may hold scope outside the delivering organization.
Vendor party. Four subtype meanings exist; overlap policy unresolved.
Contextual relationship between a party and a context. Not a person subtype; grants no authority.
Third-party approver engagement. Approval scope must be explicit per decision.
Representation relationship between a manufacturer and a representative party.
Commercial entity, separate from any document that represents it.
Source name only. Target split: ProductDefinition and AssetInstance.
Descriptive service metadata only. Executable orchestration lives in app.application.
Catalog definition: model and manufacturer part information.
Physical unit linked to a ProductDefinition. Bulk materials get no invented serial identity.
AI agent. Resource status and authority unresolved.
Vendor subtype: sells products only, such as a distributor.
Vendor subtype: manufacturer that also sells professional services.
Vendor subtype: platform through which labor is booked. Not the provider booked through it.

excluded.note: In the source model and proposed tree (document/prj_document.py) but not scaffolded in 0.9.0.
